translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Pfumu, ngeyo zebi mambu mama moso

content.text: A Yave ngeyo wuthomba ayi ngeyo wunzebi.
Ngeyo zebi thangu ndidi wuvuanda
ayi thangu ndidi wutelama ;
ngeyo weti bakula bumboti mayindu mama bu makidi thama.
Ngeyo zebi thangu ndieti totuka
ayi thangu ndieti lambalala ;
Ngeyo zebi bumboti zinzila ziama zioso.
Tuamina mambu maba va ludimi luama,
ngeyo zebi mawu moso, a Yave.
Ngeyo wunzungididi ku manima ayi ku ntuala
Ngeyo wutetika koko kuaku va minu.
Nzayilu yi phila yoyi, yididi ngolo
yitsiminanga kuidi minu ;
yididi ngolo yinangama muingi ndiyibakidila.
Kuevi ndilenda kuenda suamina phevi aku e ?
A kuevi ndilenda kuenda tinina meso maku e ?
Enati khumini ku Diyilu, ngeyo widi kuna ;
enati minu thudidi mbukꞌama ku tsina ntoto,
ngeyo widi kuna.
Enati khumini mu mavavi ma nkielo buisi ;
enati phuendi ku lubakala lu mbu,
buna kuna diaka, koko kuaku kuela kundiatisa ;
koko kuaku ku lubakala kuela kutsimbidila ngolo.
Enati khembi : “Bukiedika tombi kiela kutsueka”
vayi buna kiezila kikitukidi tombi va ndidi.
Muaki tombi kilendi ba tombi kuidi ngeyo ko ;
builu buela kienzuka banga muini
bila tombi kidi banga kiezila kuidi ngeyo.
Ngeyo wuvanga binama biama bi khati nitu ;
ngeyo wuthunga va kimosi mu vumu ki ngudi ama.
Ndikuzitisa bila ndidi vangu ki tsisi ayi kitsiminanga ;
mavanga maku madi matsiminanga ayi nzebi buawu bumboti.
Khubukulu ama yi mimvesi yisia suama va ntualꞌaku ko
mu thangu ndikubuku mu buangu kisuama ;
mu thangu ndivangu va kimosi ku tsina ntoto.
Meso maku mamona nitu ama yikambu kubuku.
Bilumbu bioso biobi wukhubikila biba bisonama mu bukuꞌaku,
tuamina lumbu kimosi mu biawu kiba.
A phila thalu mayindu maku kuidi minu, a Nzambi !
A phila woka madi !
Enati thidi ku matanga ;
buna maviokidi nzielo mu thalu ;
Bu khotukidi, minu ndidi kaka yaku.
Enati ngeyo wuzola kaka vonda mutu wumbimbi, a Nzambi !
Bika luthatukila beno luntengulanga menga !
Beti kuyolukila mu zikhanu zimbimbi ;
bobo beti kulenda beti sadila dizina diaku mu kambu fuana.
Buevi, ndilendi lenda ko bobo beti kulenda, a Yave ?
A buevi, ndilendi kakumukina ko bobo beti kufuemi e ?
Ndisi kadi diambu ko vayi kikhenene kaka ndidi kuidi bawu ;
ndieti ba tanga bambeni ziama.
Wumfiongunina, a Nzambi, ayi zaba ndimꞌama ;
wuthota ayi zaba mayindu mama.
Tala kani nzila yimbimbi yidi mu minu
ayi wundiatisa mu nzila yi mvu ka mvu.
